messages:
sam: dropped updated dashboard mock — trying a compact vertical stack for time picker + sampling. Figma link: https://www.figma.com/file/NEW_UI ira: love the vertical stack on desktop, but on narrow widths the p95 label collides with the actions. Could we move the metric label above the chart title in compact mode? leo: +1 to moving it above. Also suggest writing p95 as 'p95 — 95th percentile' (short first, explanation after) to keep the small label tight but still friendly. sam: good call. What about the heatmap legend? Current gradient bar below chart wastes space. ana: what if we make the legend a collapsible strip that can be expanded to a vertical column? default collapsed shows min/mid/max values only. leo: that solves space. UX concern: collapsing hides granularity. Maybe show ticks on hover or keyboard focus. ira: accessibility: ensure the collapsed legend has a focusable toggle with aria-expanded and a label like 'Show density legend'. sam: agreed. For the time picker, can we combine presets with a custom range pill? e.g., [1h] [6h] [Custom ▾] so it doesn't look cluttered. leo: yes; but presets need clear visual state. Contrast on active preset is low in the mock — bump the fill or add a 1px outline. ana: copy nudge: change tooltip text from 'Sampling lowers cost' to 'Sampling reduces inference cost' — clearer for new users. sam: about sampling default: engineering asked if 100% should be default. I think default 100% but surface a suggested '25% (cost saver)' callout for noisy dashboards. leo: suggestion: when user hovers over a preset sampling rate show estimated cost multiplier(e.g., '≈0.25x cost') and rough latency impact. keeps expectations set. ira: aria snippet for the sampling control I mocked: ```html
Sampling: 100% — estimated cost 1.0x
``` sam: nice. ensure the status updates on keyboard change as well. leo: small chart detail: drop 'ms' from title and show units on y-axis tick like '200 ms' — title reads cleaner that way. ira: mobile: collapsing sampling under a 'Query controls' drawer keeps primary chart area clean. add a visible label 'Sampling • 100%' so it isn't totally hidden. sam: UX question: should the heatmap use discrete buckets or a continuous gradient? discrete helps with legend reading (3-5 buckets) but gradient looks nicer. leo: go discrete for now with five buckets; we can experiment in telemetry. add a legend label that explains bucket ranges. ana: will update mocks with: metric label moved, p95 phrasing changed, compact time picker with custom pill, legend collapsible with keyboard affordance, sampling help copy updated, discrete 5-bucket heatmap. pushing v2 shortly. design-bot: new variant (compact-legend-drawer-v2) uploaded by sam. Preview: https://www.figma.com/file/NEW_UI_V2 sam: pinging eng and accessibility for sign-off once v2 is in. design-bot: thread archived.
